_doc: Interactive combat training (R02). {attack} {guard} {dodge} {draw} {finish} become the player's key names. Step ids are the contract with training_session.gd.

steps.text: Strike the instructor with the right blade: [{attack}].
Strike again, and press [{attack}] once more as the first cut ends for the left blade.
Chain all three: press [{attack}] near the end of each cut.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 - The Warrior's Guard
lessons.intro: Watch the shoulder, not the steel.

steps.text: Face him and raise your guard: hold [{guard}].
Parry: press [{guard}] just as his blow arrives (the bar runs out).

lessons.title: Lesson 3 - Strength Through Balance
lessons.intro: Do not swing at a closed guard.

steps.text: Wait. Raise [{guard}] at the last instant for a perfect parry.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 - The Falling Leaf
lessons.intro: Some blows cannot be stopped. Be elsewhere.

steps.text: His heavy blow cannot be guarded. Move [A]/[D] and dodge [{dodge}] as it falls.
He has overreached. Close in and strike: [{attack}].

lessons.title: The Commander's Trial
lessons.intro: Three opponents. Only one commits at a time. Watch them all.

steps.text: Defeat them, showing a linked combination, a parry and a clean dodge.
